name: zovo-folder-diff
displayName: Folder Compare & Directory Diff - Compare Files, Folders, Word, Excel & Binary
description: Free and offline. Compare two folders side by side with clear Left and Right panels, then open a diff for any file: text, Word (.docx, .odt, .doc), Excel (.xlsx, .xls, .ods), CSV, Parquet, PDF and binary files. Copy or delete with a preview, export the result, compare a folder with a Git branch or tag.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Comparing folders, copying and deleting work in Restricted Mode. Compare with a Git ref runs git, so it needs a trusted workspace.

enumDescriptions: Files with the same size are compared byte by byte (in the background). Exact.
Size and modified time only. Fast on huge trees and network drives, but a copy with a new time shows as changed.
folderDiff.compareMode.description: How files are compared. The toolbar can change it per compare.

folderDiff.exclude.description: Names and globs to leave out of every compare. A name matches at any depth. A trailing / matches folders only. Example: *.log, build/, src/**/*.map

folderDiff.useGitignore.description: Also leave out what .gitignore files in the compared folders ignore.

folderDiff.followSymlinks.description: Follow symbolic links into folders and files. Off: a link is compared by its target text, and link loops are harmless. On: loops are detected and reported.

folderDiff.showSame.description: Show equal files when a compare opens. Off shows the differences only; the toolbar switch changes it per compare.

folderDiff.mtimeToleranceSeconds.description: Quick mode: modified times this close count as equal (FAT and network drives store times in 2 second steps).

folderDiff.maxTextDiffMB.description: Text files larger than this open in the byte compare instead of the text diff editor.

folderDiff.maxConvertMB.description: Largest Word, Excel, Parquet or PDF file that is turned into text for the diff.

folderDiff.maxCompareRows.description: Rows per sheet or table in the Excel, CSV and Parquet diff.

folderDiff.convertTimeoutSec.description: Time limit for turning one document into text.

folderDiff.deleteToTrash.description: Delete moves files to the Trash or Recycle Bin. Off deletes them for good (the confirmation says which).

folderDiff.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating after 2 compares that finished without an error, in sessions at least 4 hours apart. "Later" asks one more time after 7 days, "No thanks" never asks again. It never asks after an error or more than 2 times. Nothing is sent anywhere.

folderDiff.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Rate, More free tools and Sponsor links at the bottom of the compare view. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Folder Diff
walkthroughs.description: Compare two folders, open the diff of any file, copy what you need.

steps.title: Compare two folders
steps.description:
Select two folders in the Explorer (Ctrl or Cmd click), right-click and choose Compare Selected Folders. Or right-click one folder and choose Compare Folder With.
[Try it on sample folders](command:folderDiff.trySample)

media.altText: Two release folders compared: Left and Right panels with full paths, changed, only left and only right files.

steps.title: Open the diff of a file
steps.description: Double-click a changed file. Text opens in the VS Code diff editor. Word, Excel, CSV, Parquet and PDF files open as text side by side. Other files show the bytes that differ.

steps.title: Copy, delete and export
steps.description: Select rows and press Copy to right, Copy to left or Delete. A confirmation lists every file first. Export saves the result as Markdown, CSV or HTML.

steps.title: Ignore rules and compare mode
steps.description:
node_modules, .git and dist are left out by default, plus what .gitignore ignores. Content mode compares bytes; Quick mode uses size and time.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22folderDiff%22%5D)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
